newsitem.title: FRANCE: Renault, GM Europe in cooperation deal.
newsitem.headline: Renault, GM Europe in cooperation deal.

text.p: Carmakers Renault, General Motors Europe and Opel AG said on Thursday they had signed a master agreement in the light commercial vehicle sector.
The deal "paves the way for a long lasting partnership to continue well beyond the year 2010," Renault said in a statement.
The deal will enable the companies to strengthen their positions in the European light commercial vehicle market and will increase the product range in the sector, Renault said.

Renault and Opel will jointly develop within Renault's engineering organisation at Creos, France, a new light commercial vehicle of 2.5 to 2.8 tonnes gross vehicle weight (GVW). It is planned to come on stream after the turn of the century.

IBC Vehicles in Luton, England, which produces the Opel/Vauxhall Frontera is to manufacture the new vehicle on behalf of Renault and Adam Opel AG. It will be marketed under the names of each of the manufacturers.
